results.name: Fingerprint uses sorted path/hash pairs and does not depend on object insertion order
Configuration requires HTTPS, valid credentials and an actual Unity project folder
Normal apply changes only requested values, re-extracts and creates recoverable backups
Different project and invalid requests are rejected without source writes
Stale entire source fingerprint rejects an otherwise valid field edit
Same job replay is idempotent even after restart and cannot be reused for a different edit
Readonly, unknown, invalid types and invalid positive health fail local domain validation
Source changed during preparation is not overwritten
Crash after preparation restarts safely and applies once
Crash after source write verifies committed values and acknowledges without writing again
Crash after one of several writes rolls back only its own output before retrying
External change after interrupted write blocks automatic recovery without any overwrite
Corrupted recovery backup is detected before restoring a partially written transaction
Snapshot payload contains no absolute project path, source body, bearer token or CSRF token
Failed ACK is retried with a new lease while the source transaction is applied only once
Outbound transport uses authenticated POST, no token in URL or body, and rejects redirects
HTTP test service receives separate authenticated poll and ACK with complete verified catalog
Idle snapshot publishes once per source fingerprint and active-job conflict does not overwrite the cloud baseline
Headless runner remains alive across failed polls and writes only user-local status without opening a port
Actual hosted worker and bridge complete password login, queued edits, temporary Unity apply and public verified result
